licensing.rule: Font binaries and generated P2prime pages are never committed; only hashes, manifests and compact metrics.

family_disjointness: fc-list inventory and text/manifest fixture search across qualification/font01 through font04, excluding generated local artifacts: none of FreeMono, FreeSans, URW Gothic, or Bitstream Charter found. FONT-01 through P2 known families excluded. FreeSans and Bitstream Charter provide sans/serif text designs; FreeMono is monospace. Reviewer should assess design similarity and Type 1 compatibility with the outline-xor proxy before acceptance.

evaluation_rules.single_use: Evaluate exactly once, with the frozen method and operating point. Any code or parameter change afterwards voids P2prime for qualification and needs a new preregistration.
evaluation_rules.rendering: Both PDFium and Poppler, at native 200/300/600 DPI, original physical coordinates.

pass_criteria.pristine_quality: Per frequent class (>=10 P2 observations), in each renderer: candidate mean and p95 pristine error <= current default.
pass_criteria.material_defects: Blinded review under FONT_04_REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md: zero identity-class defects (wrong character appearance, counter opened/closed, missing/added stroke, dot/sliver, weight/slant-class change) in the accepted sample, the rejected sample and the negative-set analogues; candidate total material-defect rate <= current default.
pass_criteria.functional: Text extraction and native search identical to current default; qpdf and OTS pass; deterministic repeat byte-identical.
pass_criteria.economy: Report distinct designs, draws per design, retired/added/net programs, font and PDF bytes. No economy threshold: economy is established on the real financial document (P3), not on P2.

evaluation_rules.no_post_hoc: No target, class, page or renderer may be excluded after P2 results are seen. Abstentions are counted by the frozen method's own rules.
evaluation_rules.criteria_interpretation: P2 criteria below are copied verbatim and apply to candidate vs default; P2 means this P2prime population for these criteria.
evaluation_rules.identity_visibility_rule: Blind review counts an identity-class defect only when visibly distinguishable at reading size from the source glyph. Visually interchangeable cross-family glyphs are allowed. Font-outline xor proxy is reported but is not a pass/fail criterion; zero identity-class defects remains required.

review_package.format: R2a v2 blind review package with separately held sealed key; see qualification/font04/R2A_BLIND_README.md
strata: all admitted substitutions, or random at least 300 stratified by face and DPI if more than 300
review_package.sampling: Specify deterministic seed and allocation before reviewing; include available strata and record shortages explicitly.
